content.doc_md:
File handling is an important part of any application.

Java has several methods for creating, reading, updating, and 
deleting files.

TheFileclass from thejava.iopackage, allows 
us to work with files.

To use theFileclass, create an object of 
the class, and specify the filename or directory name:Exampleimport java.io.File;  // Import the File class

File myObj = new File("filename.txt"); // Specify the filenameIf you don't know what a package is, read ourJava Packages Tutorial.TheFileclass has many useful methods for creating and getting information 
about files. 
For example:MethodTypeDescriptioncanRead()BooleanTests whether the file is readable or notcanWrite()BooleanTests whether the file is writable or notcreateNewFile()BooleanCreates an empty filedelete()BooleanDeletes a fileexists()BooleanTests whether the file existsgetName()StringReturns the name of the filegetAbsolutePath()StringReturns the absolute pathname of the filelength()LongReturns the size of the file in byteslist()String[]Returns an array of the files in the directorymkdir()BooleanCreates a directoryYou will learn how to create, write, read and delete files in the next chapters:Create Files »Write to Files »Read Files »Delete Files »❮ PreviousNext ❯★+1Sign in to track progress
